name: 111 會考模擬二模（康軒 1～3 冊）英語聽力（附聽力稿）
source: 康軒 111 學年國中教育會考模擬測驗（九年級，範圍 1～3 冊），答案與解析取自官方詳解

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
Ben was tired, but he still practiced dancing with his daughter.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：Ben 很累，但他仍和他女兒一起練習跳舞。（關鍵字：tired／practiced dancing with his daughter）

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
We decided not to eat at that restaurant because there were too many people.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：我們決定不在那家餐廳吃飯，因為人太多了。（關鍵字：decided not to eat）

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
The weather was getting cloudy, so the boys stopped playing soccer.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：天氣漸漸變陰，所以這些男孩們停止踢足球。（關鍵字：cloudy／stopped playing）

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
How long did it take Ryan to find the new job?
questions.e: 中譯：Ryan 花了多長時間找到這份新工作？→ 大約兩週。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Who is the young man in the living room?
questions.e: 中譯：客廳裡的年輕人是誰？→ 他不是 James 嗎？

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Where did Ethan stay when his parents were not home?
questions.e: 中譯：Ethan 的父母不在家時，他待在哪裡？→ 在他奶奶家。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
How often do you go to the supermarket?
questions.e: 中譯：你多久去一次超市？→ 幾乎每週。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
What were you doing when Julia woke up?
questions.e: 中譯：Julia 醒來時你正在做什麼？→ 我正在吃晚餐。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
What day is the meeting with Mr. Beckham?
questions.e: 中譯：和 Beckham 先生的會議是在星期幾？→ 在星期四。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
How many eggs are there in the box?
questions.e: 中譯：盒子裡有多少顆蛋？→ 有一打。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Kevin is late again. Let’s wait for him for 10 minutes.
o: Well, he’s sick and won’t come.
Don’t worry. He’ll be on time.
questions.e: 中譯：Kevin 又遲到了。我們等他十分鐘吧。→ 嗯，他生病了，不會來。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: I still don’t get it. Why can’t Kelly go to the museum with us?
W: She has to take care of Sophia.
M: It is good to take children to museums. We can learn a lot in museums, and children can learn more.
W: Are you serious? Sophia is too young. She can’t even walk, and she could cry at any time.
M: All right.
Q: How old might Sophia be?
questions.e: 由「Sophia 還太小了。她甚至不會走路，而且她隨時都可能會哭」，可知 Sophia 可能只有一歲，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Excuse me, how much is the watermelon?
W: 100 dollars for one, and 250 for three. They are very sweet.
M: I’ll take one. There are only four people in my family. We can’t finish three watermelons.
W: You can make watermelon juice. It’s good in summer. What about 220 for three?
M: No, thanks. I’ll just take one.
Q: How much did the man spend in the end?
questions.e: 由「一個一百元」和「我只要一個」，可知男子最後花了一百元，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: I listened to Ivana’s The History of Magic last night.
W: Do you like it?
M: Of course. Her music is special. Her songs are not just about love.
W: Right. She even has a song about math.
M: And a song about French fries.
W: People never feel bored with her music.
Q: What are the man and the woman talking about?
questions.e: 由「她的音樂很特別」及談論到她的有關於數學或薯條的歌，可知是在談論關於一位歌手，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: Good afternoon, sir. How can I help you?
M: Hi, I’d like to check in.
W: May I have your name, please?
M: William Parker.
W: OK, one moment, please. Yes, Mr. Parker. A room for two nights. Please sign here.
M: OK. Can I have a wake-up call at 7 o’clock tomorrow?
W: Sure. And you can have breakfast from 7 to 10.
M: Thank you.
W: Here is your key. Your room is on the 10th floor, and the room number is 101. Thank you for staying with us.
Q: What is the woman?
questions.e: 由女子接待客人、協助辦理入住及最後說「感謝您入住我們飯店」，可知她是飯店櫃檯的「接待員」，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: Look at this gray rabbit! It’s so cute. I like that brown one, too.
M: But they are only one month old. It will be hard to take care of them.
W: Well, all right. What about the white dog? It keeps looking at us.
M: Having a dog sounds good to me. Let’s ask the woman over there to learn more about the dog.
W: Good idea.
Q: What are the man and the woman doing?
questions.e: 由「照顧牠們會很辛苦」和「養狗對我來說聽起來不錯」，可知他們在挑選新寵物，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: My son, Gary, wants to be a police officer in the future. He is smart and good at fixing problems. He also enjoys helping people. He speaks English well, so he can even help foreigners in need. However, he runs slowly and can’t jump high. Will he be able to catch bad guys like other police officers? Will he get hurt at work? As a mother, I’m a little worried.
Q: What school subject might Gary NOT be good at?
questions.e: 由「他跑得慢並且跳不高」，可知 Gary 不擅長體育，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: It’s almost noon. I can’t wait to go to Danny’s birthday party.
M: I can’t, either. I bought a toy car for him. He’ll love it for sure. By the way, the party starts at 3:30, right?
W: Yes, but I’m thinking of going earlier. It is Emily’s first party for her son. She might need some help.
M: OK. Let’s go after lunch.
Q: What might the man and the woman do next?
questions.e: 由「快中午了」和「我們午餐後就去吧」，可知他們接下來可能會先吃午餐，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: Guess what! Frank goes to the gym every day after work.
M: Ha! I only saw him once last month. I go to the gym every day.
W: Really? So he lied to me?
M: I’m afraid so. Think about it. He didn’t get any thinner. He still looks the same.
W: Well, maybe you’re right.
Q: Do the man and the woman believe Frank?
o: The man does, but the woman doesn’t.
The woman does, but the man doesn’t.
questions.e: 由男子說「恐怕是」及女子說「或許你是對的」，可知他們不太相信 Frank，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: Let’s buy some new shirts for Dad. All his shirts are old.
M: Dad seldom wears shirts now. He likes T-shirts more.
W: But he has enough T-shirts. Maybe we should buy him shoes.
M: That’s not a good idea. We don’t know his size.
W: What about... a birthday cake?
M: Dad is already too heavy.
W: Hey! Why do you keep saying no to my ideas?
M: Because they are not good ideas.
W: At least I have ideas. You didn’t think of any!
Q: Why is the woman NOT happy?
o: The man bought her a terrible gift.
Her father doesn’t like the birthday gifts.
The man doesn’t like her ideas.
questions.e: 由女子提議買襯衫、鞋子或生日蛋糕給爸爸，但男子一直否定，可知男子不喜歡這些主意，並且女子因此而不高興，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Honey, I’ll be home a little late tonight. On my way to work this morning, I noticed a new bakery baking apple pies. The apple pies smelled really good, and I ordered two. One is for my parents, and the other is for us. The bakery is close to my parents’ house, so I asked them to send both pies there. That way, my parents can try the pie first. I will pick up the one for us after work. You can have dinner first if the kids are hungry.
Q: Where will the man go before he goes home?
questions.e: 由男子要麵包店把兩個派都送去他父母家，並說「我下班後會去拿我們的那一個」，可知男子回家前會先去他父母家，故選(B)。
